title: A right coideal ideal is zero or the whole Hopf algebra
statement: Let k be a field and A a commutative Hopf k-algebra. Let J be an ideal of A. Suppose that, for every x∈J, Δ(x) belongs to the k-linear span of tensors a⊗b with a∈J and b∈A. Then J is the zero ideal or the whole ring.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [HopfAlgebra k A] (J : Ideal A) (_hJ : ∀ x ∈ J, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k A A | ∃ a ∈ J, ∃ b : A, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}), J = ⊥ ∨ J = ⊤
